typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		PaymentDate as string,
		GenderCode as string,
		AgeGroup as string,
		StateCountyCode as string,
		Hospice as string,
		ESRD as string,
		Inst as string,
		RiskAdjFacPrtA as string,
		RiskAdjFacPrtB as string,
		NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA as string,
		AdjReasonCode as string,
		PayAdjStartDate as timestamp,
		PayAdjEndDate as timestamp,
		PrtDRAFac as string,
		PrtDLowIncomeInd as string,
		NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  MMR.PAYMENT_DT AS PaymentDate, NH.SBSB_ID AS SBSB_ID, \' \' AS AgeGroup, MMR.SRC_MBR_GNDR_CD AS GenderCode, MMR.STATE_COUNTRY_CD AS StateCountyCode, MMR.LOW_INCOME_MI_PART_D AS PrtDLowIncomeInd, MMR.HOSPICE AS Hospice, MMR.ESRD AS ESRD, \' \' AS Inst, MMR.ADJ_RISK_FAC_PART_A AS RiskAdjFacPrtA, MMR.ADJ_RISK_FAC_PART_B AS RiskAdjFacPrtB, MMR.RISK_ADJ_FAC_PART_D AS PrtDRAFac, MMR.ADJ_REASON_CD AS AdjReasonCode, MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT AS PayAdjStartDate, MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT AS PayAdjEndDate, MMR.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_PART_A AS NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA, MMR.NO_OF_PAY_ADJ_MON_PART_D AS NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD FROM  PSGL.CMS_MMR_RAW MMR JOIN PSGL.MMR_CA_LOAD NH  ON NH.MEME_HICN = MMR.CMS_MBR_HIC_NBR_ID AND NH.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR = MMR.CMS_CNTRCT_NBR  AND NH.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID = MMR.CMS_PLAN_BNFT_PKG_ID AND MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_STRT_DT BETWEEN NH.MEPE_EFF_DT AND NH.MEPE_TERM_DT AND MMR.ORIG_MSA_PAY_ADJSTMNT_END_DT BETWEEN NH.MEPE_EFF_DT AND NH.MEPE_TERM_DT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBSQL
SRCOLEDBSQL derive(AgeGroup_DC = toString(AgeGroup),
		ESRD_DC = toString(ESRD),
		AdjReasonCode_DC = toString(AdjReasonCode),
		GenderCode_DC = toString(GenderCode),
		StateCountyCode_DC = toString(StateCountyCode),
		NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD_DC = toString(NoofPayAdjMonthsPrtD),
		PrtDRAFac_DC = toString(PrtDRAFac),
		PaymentDate_DC = toString(PaymentDate),
		Inst_DC = toString(Inst),
		PayAdjEndDate_DC = toDate(toString(PayAdjEndDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA_DC = toString(NoofPayAdjMonthPrtA),
		PayAdjStartDate_DC = toDate(toString(PayAdjStartDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		PrtDLowIncomeInd_DC = toString(PrtDLowIncomeInd),
		Hospice_DC = toString(Hospice),
		RiskAdjFacPrtB_DC = toString(RiskAdjFacPrtB),
		RiskAdjFacPrtA_DC = toString(RiskAdjFacPrtA),
		SBSB_ID_DC = toString(SBSB_ID)) ~> DCNVCOMBINEDATA
